name: event-sourcing-cqrs-design
description: Design event-sourcing and/or CQRS. Event store selection, event schema (immutable facts), aggregate boundaries, projection/read-model design, command vs query separation, consistency boundaries, snapshotting, versioning / upcasting, replay capability, compliance implications (GDPR right-to-delete in immutable store). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
